info.name: Enveda Content API (WordPress REST wp/v2) Taxonomy API

description.content:
Enveda publishes enveda.com on WordPress, which exposes the WordPress REST API at https://enveda.com/wp-json/. The wp/v2 namespace is anonymously readable and returns the company's news releases, In-Veda blog posts, marketing pages, leadership and team profiles (`person`), clinical-trial site listings (`wpsl_stores`), the media library, taxonomies and a site-wide search endpoint as JSON.

This document was DERIVED mechanically by API Evangelist from the route-discovery document served at https://enveda.com/wp-json/ on 2026-08-04 — every path, method and parameter below is taken verbatim from that descriptor. Enveda does not publish an OpenAPI definition of its own, and this is not a product API: it is the content API the CMS exposes. Write operations exist on these routes but require authentication (WordPress Application Passwords over HTTP Basic).
